source.publisher: NASA Science / Space Telescope Science Institute
source.imageNature: Display-graded optical color composite; not calibrated photometry or a scientific flux product.

publisherWcs.pixelConvention: Publisher AVM/TAN registration. Image pixels are addressed here with zero-based x-right, y-down coordinates; the AVM reference pixel may lie outside this released detail crop.
publisherWcs.quality: Publisher registration copied from the STScI Astropix catalogue; not independently fitted or checked against matched stars. The TIFF also contains legacy virtual-observatory metadata referring to a larger source canvas, so use this catalogue registration for the released 4806 x 3364 derivative.

originalPixelCoordinates.convention: Zero-based top-left origin; left/top inclusive and right/bottom exclusive.

crop.transformation: Native 512 x 512 pixel crop with no resize or structure mask; Adobe RGB (1998) converted to sRGB IEC61966-2.1 for deterministic display RGB.

reproduction.command: mkdir -p .local/nebula-lab/orion-source labs/nebula/models/orion-structure-benchmark && curl --fail --location --output .local/nebula-lab/orion-source/STScI-01EVT7Y95A2C07EEX772ZV79V3.tif https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/missions/hubble/releases/2006/01/STScI-01EVT7Y95A2C07EEX772ZV79V3.tif && sips -c 512 512 --cropOffset 650 1700 -m '/System/Library/ColorSync/Profiles/sRGB Profile.icc' -s format png .local/nebula-lab/orion-source/STScI-01EVT7Y95A2C07EEX772ZV79V3.tif --out labs/nebula/models/orion-structure-benchmark/source.png

crop.selection: The fixed field contains the resolved LL Orionis bow shock and secondary shock filaments, diffuse emission gradients, dark gaps, and several point sources. Selection is the only authored spatial input.

distanceEvidence.paper: The distance to the Orion Nebula
distanceEvidence.method: VLBA trigonometric parallax of Orion Nebula Cluster radio stars

physicalScale.interpretation: These values convert angular separation into projected XY scale at the cluster distance. They do not measure the line-of-sight positions, thicknesses, or gas depth of structures in the crop.

constraints: A single display composite constrains projected morphology only; it cannot recover true 3D depth.
The color channels mix broad optical bands and narrow emission lines from HST and ESO data; pixel values are display RGB, not calibrated fluxes.
Do not infer geometric depth from brightness, color, apparent overlap, bow-shock shape, or the cluster distance alone.
Any later 3D reconstruction must label depth placement and thickness as authored priors or hypotheses, not observations.
Run the same generic extraction settings as the first native 512 px case; do not encode Orion or LL Orionis feature names into reusable algorithms.
